versions.changelog:
- Improved documentation outlining the structured procedure for diagnosing code smells.
- Added clear guidance on scope establishment, evidence collection, and smell identification.
- Introduced detailed requirements for diagnosis findings, including confidence and impact reporting.
- Emphasized use of false-positive checks and not modifying business code unless requested.
- Provided quick-reference links to the smell catalog, detection guide, and refactoring map.
- Listed common diagnostic mistakes to avoid.
